name: CMSC, Inc.
summary: Based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, CMSC, Inc. is a key player in the integrated circuit sector, specializing in both the conceptualization and production of advanced ICs. The company's reach extends across Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, and various international markets. Its extensive product portfolio features components such as modules, system-in-packages (SiP), printed circuit boards (PCBs), and tailored system designs. Beyond hardware, CMSC offers a broad array of specialized services. These include physical design, optimization, and System-on-Chip (SoC) integration; comprehensive analog IC design (covering both front-end and back-end aspects); intricate IC chip engineering; and diligent management of mass production processes. Furthermore, CMSC provides System-on-Chip (SoC) and Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) design expertise, alongside valuable intellectual property (IP) solutions and critical process migration services. The company was founded in 1990.
